title: Refuse complex LTYPE data in R11/R12 DXF output
scope: Do not silently omit complex LTYPE segment metadata when writing the AC1009 (R11/R12) DXF profile.

autodeskRelease12Reference.section: TABLES / LTYPE, lines 1114-1116 in the accessible text
autodeskRelease12Reference.finding: The R12 LTYPE field inventory lists name, flags, description, alignment, dash count, total pattern length, and repeated group-49 dash lengths only. It defines no complex-element fields.

autodeskCurrentLtypeReference.finding: The later LTYPE schema defines group 74 complex element types and associated groups 75, 340, 46, 50, 44, 45, and 9.

implementation: writeLineType now refuses AC1009 when any normalized segment has nonzero shapeFlags, before opening the record scope. Simple dash-only LTYPE output remains supported. AC1014+ complex output remains unchanged.

verification.profiles: ASCII and Binary AC1009 complex-text LTYPE attempts preserve a pre-existing destination sentinel and leave the callback uncommitted; retry through the same writer at AC1014 succeeds, and fresh typed readback verifies the complex segment flag and text payload.
verification.build: cmake --build build --target libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests -j4 passed with project warning-as-error settings.

limits: Generated direct-writer refusal/retry and self-readback only.
Does not qualify complex LTYPE native rendering, external producer prevalence, or STYLE font graph closure.
The test retries at AC1014 because AC1012 is not an enabled top-level DXF writer target in this repository.
